 Order

The present petition under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nyayik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 has been filed on behalf of the petitioner seeking grant of regular bail in FIR No. 90/2021, dated 11.03.2021 for offence under Sections 363/376/368/344/354 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 6 of the Prevention of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, registered at Police Station Babu Haridas Nagar, Delhi.

entities.text: Prevention of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012

sentences.text:
2. The learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the present bail application,
as the matter is listed for final hearing before the learned Trial Court.
3. The present bail application is, accordingly, dismissed as withdrawn.
